text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, both the same. Saw a 40 mm slice off 100 x 40 mm bar and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square it to 96 long, 40 tall and 40 wide.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw out a step 66 long and 28 deep, leaving a tall end 30 long and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a tail 12 thick. The tall end's back face goes on the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File a 12 x 12 mm 45 degree chamfer along the bottom of the back face:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it keeps the block off the girder's root fillet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tall end: two 6.6 mm holes through, 10 each side of centre, 31 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: counterbore 11 mm, 6.5 deep, from the front for M6 cap screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tail: one 11 mm hole, 13 from its end, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back face flat on the plate front, bottom on the flange top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tail out past the flange tip. Two M6 x 30 screws into the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a flange offcut it sits flat with no rock at the fillet.
